title: Swiss catalog model metadata (v2)
description: models/<name>/metadata.yaml for a v2 model: what the model is, its default variant and tuning results. Edited in place.

series.description: Groups related models, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-0731.

defaultVariant.description: The variant a UI preselects; the first by id when unset.

origins.description: Where variants came from: written by hand, submitted through Baseline Hub, or produced by a tuner such as AutoTune. Display only, like tuning, and edited in place. A variant without an entry is not recorded.

version.description: Legacy: the v1 version measured, so the v1 index.json lists the result. An entry for variants that exist only in v2 has no v1 version and omits it.

baseline.description: The variant measured as the baseline.

report.description: File name of the measurement beside this metadata.yaml, such as the AutoTune HTML report, served at <site>models/<name>/<report> with the site from catalog.yaml. Optional: without one the result has no report link, and the tuned variant's origin, when recorded, links to where it was made.

source.description: Absent only for a model with no weights, such as a mock server: every variant then sets values.model.localPath to "", mounting none.

metric.description: What uplift measures, as an AutoTune measure: a throughput (tokens/min, total or per GPU, or completed requests/s), or a per-request speed or latency with an optional statistic, such as ttft_ms@p90. Uplift is always the percent better, positive meaning an improvement: for a latency, the percent it fell.

variant.description: The variant version this is the origin of.

tool.description: How it was made: manual (written by hand), baseline-hub (submitted through Baseline Hub and measured there), or autotune (found by an AutoTune campaign).

by.description: Who made it: the user who submitted it, or who created the campaign. A name tag only.

url.description: Where it was made: the campaign or the Hub submission.

policy.description: autotune only: the search policy that found it, <name>@<version>, such as llm-agent@1.7.

from.description: The variant version it was made from, such as the baseline a campaign tuned.
